title: Pokémon TCG 151 S&V 158/165 Korean Pokeball Reverse Holo Safety Goggles
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This rare and highly sought-after Pokémon TCG card is a must-have addition to any collector's deck. Featuring the Reverse Holo Safety Goggles design, this card is from the Scarlet & Violet set and is a Basic stage Pokémon type. It is also an Uncommon rarity and is written in Korean language. 

The card's number is 158/165 and it belongs to the CCG Individual Cards and Collectible Card Games categories. It is suitable for players aged 4 and above and is perfect for those who enjoy the Pokémon TCG game. Add this card to your collection today and enhance your deck's strength!
